app "Cake price" bread plum

state butter money = 0
state other money = 0
state hours num = 1
state margin num = 30
field flour "Flour and sugar"
field butter "Butter and eggs"
field other "Boxes and other"
field hours "Hours of work"

"Cost" cost head
"Price" round(cost * (1 + margin / 100)) big

request: how much power have we used this month?
a spending tracker for my business costs each month
program:
app "Business costs" bag plum
table cost what text, amount money, note text?
state m date = today
let spent = sum(cost.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 200000 "Monthly budget"
screen main "Spend" wallet
  monthnav m
  "Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
  if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
  goal spent, budget, "spent"
  form cost
screen charts "Charts" chart
  list cost month of m by day

request: flashcard boxes with know and miss btns
program:
app "Box cards" brain plum
table card front text, back text, box num 1..3 = 1
state lvl num = 1
state flip bool = no
row gap 1
  each [1, 2, 3]
    button "Box" it fill if(lvl = it, accent, soft) tap set lvl = it
"Cards in this box" count(card where box = lvl) faint
each card where box = lvl sort at top 1 as c
  stack card gap 2 tap set flip = not flip
    if flip
      c.back big
    else
      c.front big
  row gap 1
    button "Know" tap set c.box = min(c.box + 1, 3) then set flip = no
    button "Miss" tap set c.box = 1 then set flip = no
form card, "Add card"

request: what homework is late for my kids?
program:
app "Homework" pencil ocean
table hw subject pick Maths|English|Urdu|Science|Islamiat|Other = Maths, task text, due date, done bool, note text?
let late = count(hw where done = no and due < today)
remind "Homework is due tomorrow" at hw.due - 1d at 17:00
"Late" late big color if(late > 0, bad, good)
each hw where done = no sort due as h
  row card gap 1 tap edit h
    stack grow
      h.subject bold
      h.task faint
    h.due color if(h.due < today, bad, muted)
    toggle h.done
form hw

request: 6 categories each with a limit, like 30000 for Rent, and a drawing of rectangles showing spend.
program:
app "Household" home mint
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 30000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"
setting lim_transport money = 5000 "Transport limit"
setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k
  let spent = sum(expense.amount month of m where category = k)
  let lim = if(k = Rent, lim_rent, if(k = Groceries, lim_groceries, if(k = School, lim_school, if(k = Transport, lim_transport, if(k = Medicine, lim_medicine, lim_eid)))))
  stack gap 1
    row
      k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
list expense month of m by day
daybars last 7 days, sum(expense.amount on it)

request: hug countr with a count to 10 and undo
program:
app "Hugs" heart slate
table hug
setting target num = 10 "Count to"
let n = count(hug today)
draw width 240 tap add hug
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
button "Undo" tap remove last(hug today)
button "Reset today" tap remove all hug today
remind "Time for hugs" at 7:30

request: 7 days ahead of expiry a reminder fires at 9:00. Please include: a count of papers not yet renewed, a tick box, the name and expiry for each, and a list of renewed ones.
program:
app "Car papers" car ink
table paper name text, expires date, renewed bool
remind "Car paper expires soon" at paper.expires - 7d at 9:00
count(paper where renewed = no) "open" head
each paper where renewed = no sort expires as r
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    toggle r.renewed
    stack grow
      r.name bold
      r.expires small color if(r.expires < today, bad, muted)
form paper
"Done" faint
list paper where renewed = yes

request: A Today page lists each routine with a tick box and its day streak, and a Stats page shows the percent done in 30 days, because the baby routine keeps changing.
program:
app "Baby routine" baby ocean
table routine name text
table routine_done routine ref routine
let n = count(routine)
screen main "Today" check
  count(routine_done today) "of" n "done today" head
  each routine
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        streak(it.routine_done) "day streak" faint
      toggle it.routine_done
  form routine
screen stats "Stats" chart
  stat round(count(routine_done last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% in 30 days"
  heat last 70 days, count(routine_done on it), n
